name: Cloudflare Tunnel
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Runs cloudflared, which connects a Cloudflare Tunnel so services on this node can be reached through Cloudflare without opening ports. Create the tunnel in Cloudflare's dashboard and paste its token.
startup: if [ -z "${TUNNEL_TOKEN:-}" ]; then echo "Set Tunnel token in the server's settings first: create a tunnel in Cloudflare's dashboard and copy its token."; exit 1; fi; exec ./cloudflared tunnel --no-autoupdate --metrics 0.0.0.0:{{SERVER_PORT}} --protocol {{TUNNEL_TRANSPORT_PROTOCOL}} --loglevel {{TUNNEL_LOGLEVEL}} run

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Cloudflare Tunnel: downloads cloudflared from its GitHub releases,
# checked against GitHub's SHA-256. The tunnel itself is set up in
# Cloudflare's dashboard; its token is a server setting.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "cloudflared has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

tag=$(gh-release tag cloudflare/cloudflared "${VERSION:-latest}") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 2026.11.0, then reinstall."

if [ -x cloudflared ] && [ "$(cat .cloudflared-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "cloudflared $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading cloudflared $tag"
    gh-release download cloudflare/cloudflared "$tag" "cloudflared-linux-$arch" cloudflared.new
    chmod 0755 cloudflared.new
    mv -f cloudflared.new cloudflared
    echo "$tag" > .cloudflared-version
fi
echo "Installed cloudflared $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The cloudflared version to install, such as 2026.11.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Tunnel token
variables.description: The tunnel's token from Cloudflare's dashboard (the long value after --token). The server won't start without one.

variables.name: Protocol
variables.description: How cloudflared connects to Cloudflare: auto, quic, or http2 (for networks that block UDP).

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: How much cloudflared logs: debug, info, warn, error or fatal.
